frame: Shelf frame: origin on the spine tube axis at the plate's underside; +X toward the skeleton's front, +Y its left, +Z up.
status: First design for review; geometry checks only. The tube size is from the user; fasteners and clearances are print hypotheses.

case_screws.note: M2.5 x 16-18 mm from below through plate, case stand-off and Pi into the AI HAT+ spacers
